item.title: CrossTalk Bullhorns: Trapped
item.description: The US-Israel war on Iran is changing the world on a scale hard to grasp. The international system is witnessing an extreme shock. The US is experiencing a strategic defeat at the hands of a regional power. The world we once knew is quickly disappearing. CrossTalking with Dmitry Babich and Tarik Cyril Amar.

item.title: Rock and a hard place
item.description: Donald Trump’s arsenal of ultimatums, temper tantrums, and expletives are not delivering the desired results. Iran will not simply surrender; it doesn’t have to. It has many cards to play. Trump doesn’t have a winning strategy, Iran does. CrossTalking with Larry Johnson and Ethan Levins.

item.title: CrossTalk Bullhorns: No peace
item.description: Vice President J.D. Vance left Islamabad without a deal as the Americans like to put it. It was always unlikely any progress would be made to end the war the US and Israel started. Clearly, this conflict is far from over. Also, NATO has fallen on hard times. We explain why. CrossTalking with Mark Sleboda and George Szamuely.

item.title: Uncertain ceasefire
item.description: On the face of it, the US and Iran have agreed to a two-week ceasefire. There is not much agreement beyond that. Both sides have starkly different approaches and agendas. But one thing is certain: American military might has failed to subdue Iran. We are in a new geopolitical moment. CrossTalking with Marco Carnelos, Ali Mamouri, and Maral Karimi.

item.title: No good options
item.description: When it comes to the war on Iran, we can clearly observe parallel universes. In the Trump universe, there is the demand that Iran accept defeat. In the other universe, the US is experiencing a massive strategic defeat. Obviously, this war is far from over. Next stop: boots on the ground. CrossTalking with Joshua Landis, Lionel, and Eddie Gonzales.

item.title: Fake talks, long war
item.description: Donald Trump’s address to the nation revealed his administration has no idea how to end the war it started. Full of thunderous bluster, the president continues to claim there are on-going negotiations with Tehran. No such negotiations are happening. This is Trump’s forever war. CrossTalking with Kevork Almassian, Setareh Sadeqi, and Abdolreza Alami.

item.title: Talks vs peace
item.description: The Trump administration is signaling it wants talks with Iran. But toward what end? Given the administration’s track record, talks are a deception and a tactic for further escalation. To date, there is no indication the US and Israel want peace with Iran. CrossTalking with Sami Al-Arian, Jenin Younes, and Julia Rokinfard.

item.title: Buyer’s remorse
item.description: Call it buyer’s remorse or the search for an off-ramp, it doesn’t matter, Trump wants out of a war he started and can’t finish. However, getting out and ending this conflict are not the same. Israel still has a say and importantly, Iran has veto power. CrossTalking with Stanley L. Cohen, Abdel Bari Atwan, and Kanwal Sibal.
